name: Human
description: Short-lived, endlessly ambitious, and found in every corner of the world.

name: High Elf
description: Cool-headed scholars of long memory, raised on cantrips and centuries-old grudges.

name: Wood Elf
description: Quiet-footed forest dwellers who trust the treeline more than any road.

name: Drow
description: Underdark elves of ruthless courts, sun-blind and fluent in leverage.

name: Eladrin
description: Feywild elves whose mood turns with the season, and whose season turns on a whim.

name: Sea Elf
description: Salt-scaled elves who breathe water and consider the shore a strange, dry country.

name: Shadar-kai
description: Elves marked by the Shadowfell, hungry for sensation to prove they still feel.

name: Hill Dwarf
description: Stubborn, warm-hearted crafters with long memories and longer feuds.

name: Mountain Dwarf
description: Armoured from birth, raised on stone-lore and the ethics of a well-made wall.

name: Duergar
description: Grey dwarves forged by slavery and spite, gifted with invisibility and grim patience.

name: Lightfoot Halfling
description: Charming, unremarkable, and impossible to find when they'd rather not be.

name: Stout Halfling
description: Small, tough, and famously hard to poison — a trait with a story behind it.

name: Rock Gnome
description: Tinkerers who fill a room with clockwork and never quite finish any of it.

name: Forest Gnome
description: Illusion-touched hedge folk who talk to small animals and are usually believed.

name: Deep Gnome (Svirfneblin)
description: Stone-grey survivors of the deep tunnels, cautious to the point of superstition.

name: Half-Elf
description: At home everywhere and belonging nowhere, which they've learned to make useful.

name: Half-Orc
description: Built to endure, and tired of being complimented only on that.

name: Tiefling
description: Horned inheritors of an infernal bargain nobody alive agreed to.

name: Dragonborn
description: Scaled and breath-blessed, raised to believe a clan's honour is a load-bearing thing.

name: Aasimar
description: Celestial-touched mortals with a guiding voice they can't always switch off.

name: Air Genasi
description: Elemental-blooded and lighter than they look; drafts follow them indoors.

name: Earth Genasi
description: Slow to move and slower to change, with stone growing where they stand still.

name: Fire Genasi
description: Hair like a banked flame and a temper with a documented ignition point.

name: Water Genasi
description: Never quite dry, never quite still, and unbothered by the deepest water.

name: Goliath
description: Mountain-bred giants-kin who keep a scrupulous mental ledger of favours owed.

name: Firbolg
description: Enormous, gentle forest-keepers who would rather turn invisible than argue.

name: Tabaxi
description: Cat-folk wanderers driven by curiosity that outpaces their sense of self-preservation.

name: Kenku
description: Flightless crow-folk who speak in borrowed voices and remember every one.

name: Lizardfolk
description: Cold-blooded pragmatists whose morality is entirely a question of resource management.

name: Tortle
description: Shell-backed nomads who carry their home and their calm everywhere.

name: Triton
description: Deep-sea guardians with an inherited sense of duty and surface-world superiority.

name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
description: Almost human, almost warm, and deeply practised at seeming both.

name: Bugbear
description: Enormous goblinoids with an unsettling gift for arriving quietly.

name: Goblin
description: Small, fast, and endlessly inventive with things they were told not to touch.

name: Hobgoblin
description: Disciplined militarists who treat a legion's paperwork as sacred text.

name: Kobold
description: Draconic scrappers who thrive in numbers and outlast anyone who underestimates a trap.

name: Orc
description: Relentless and fast, with a culture of endurance that outsiders read as fury.

name: Changeling
description: Born faceless, they wear identities like coats and lose track of the original.

name: Kalashtar
description: Bonded to a dream-spirit that shares their skull and disagrees with them politely.

name: Shifter
description: Descendants of lycanthropes who can call the beast up briefly, and pay for it after.

name: Warforged
description: Built for a war that ended, now working out what a person is supposed to want.

name: Githyanki
description: Astral raiders raised on vengeance, silver swords, and an inherited grudge against illithids.

name: Githzerai
description: Monastic mind-disciplinarians who built order out of raw Limbo by sheer will.

name: Satyr
description: Fey revellers with hooves, horns, and an allergy to any plan longer than a night.

name: Centaur
description: Plains-born and proud, with strong opinions about stairs and indoor living.

name: Minotaur
description: Horned and unmistakable, forever navigating a world built at the wrong height.

name: Loxodon
description: Elephantine and unhurried, with a memory that treats forgiveness as a deliberate act.

name: Vedalken
description: Blue-skinned perfectionists who consider an unrevised opinion a personal failure.

name: Simic Hybrid
description: Volunteered for biomancy and came back with extra limbs and no regrets.

name: Harengon
description: Rabbit-folk travellers with a lucky streak and an instinct for the road out.

name: Owlin
description: Silent-winged night flyers who make excellent scouts and terrible housemates.

name: Fairy
description: Palm-sized, winged, and quietly furious about being picked up.

name: Plasmoid
description: An amorphous ooze-person who can pour through a keyhole and hold a grudge.

name: Thri-kreen
description: Four-armed mantis nomads who don't sleep and find the habit alarming in others.

name: Autognome
description: A gnome's clockwork servant still following instructions from an inventor long dead.

name: Aarakocra
description: Bird-folk of the high peaks who measure a place by its updrafts.

name: Grung
description: Poisonous tree-frog folk with a rigid colour-coded caste system they take very seriously.

name: Elf (Ancestry)
description: Long-lived and deliberate, treating a human lifetime as an interesting short story.

name: Leshy
description: A nature spirit wearing a body of gourd, leaf, or fungus, newly and joyfully alive.

name: Goblin (Ancestry)
description: Fire-loving, song-making survivors who have recently decided to be everyone's friend.

name: Ratfolk (Ysoki)
description: Cheek-pouched scavengers and traders who know every tunnel under every city.

name: Tengu
description: Crow-folk wanderers, famously unlucky to insult and famously good with a blade.

name: Kitsune
description: Fox-spirits who wear a human face and count their tails as a résumé.

name: Android
description: A synthetic body housing a nanite soul, reborn with fragments of someone else's memories.

name: Fleshwarp
description: Remade by magic into something new, and rarely asked first.

name: Poppet
description: An animate doll of cloth and stuffing, cheerfully aware of every seam.

name: Skeleton (Ancestry)
description: Walking bones with a personality intact and a diplomatic problem in most towns.

name: Dhampir
description: Half-vampire, fully mortal, and permanently on the wrong side of a rumour.

name: Strix
description: Winged, blade-taloned nightfolk with generations of good reason to distrust settlers.

name: Conrasu
description: Wind-souls in self-built shells, treating each body as a crafted work in progress.

name: Sylph
description: Air-touched and secretive, hearing whispers on drafts nobody else notices.

name: Ifrit
description: Fire-blooded and theatrical, incapable of a small entrance.

name: Oread
description: Earth-touched, literal-minded, and immovable once a decision is made.

name: Undine
description: Water-blooded drifters who take the shape of whatever vessel life pours them into.

name: Vanara
description: Monkey-folk with prehensile tails, quick fingers, and quicker mockery.

name: Samsaran
description: Reborn again and again, haunted by skills learned in lives they can't fully recall.

name: Nagaji
description: Serpent-folk raised as the loyal servants of naga royalty, for better and worse.

name: Grippli
description: Tree-frog folk of the deep swamp, expert with blowguns and swamp pharmacology.

name: Selkie
description: Seal-folk who shed their skin to walk ashore, and lose everything if it's stolen.

name: Huldra
description: Beautiful from the front, hollow bark from behind, and never insulted twice.

name: Rusalka
description: A drowned spirit bound to river reeds, laughing in a voice that carries too far.

name: Dullahan
description: A headless rider who carries their own head and knows exactly whose name comes next.

name: Jinn-born
description: Smokeless-fire heritage, bound by the exact wording of every promise they make.

name: Tanuki
description: Shapeshifting racoon-dogs, famous for illusions, sake, and cheerfully bad faith.

name: Dryad
description: Bound to one tree, dying with it, and therefore an extremely committed local.

name: Redcap
description: A small, iron-shod horror whose hat must stay wet, by any means available.

name: Brownie
description: House-spirit who works for cream and leaves forever if you offer them clothes.

name: Tikbalang
description: Long-limbed horse-headed trickster who turns forest paths into circles for fun.

name: Nixie
description: Freshwater fey who bargain in song and consider drowning a negotiating position.

name: Alp
description: A night-spirit that sits on sleeping chests, feeding on dreams and denying it.

name: Emberkin
description: Survivors of a fire that should have killed them, now warm to the touch and never cold.

name: Glasswrought
description: A body of fused sand and soul-glass — beautiful, translucent, and always one fall from ruin.

name: Tidebound
description: Drowned once and returned, with strength that rises and falls with the moon.

name: Sablefolk
description: Their shadow moves a half-second early, and they've learned to watch it for warnings.

name: Hollowborn
description: Born without a name-soul; they must borrow, steal, or earn one before they fade.

name: Anadi
description: Spider-folk who spin between two shapes and never quite trust a stranger who arrived without a story to trade.

name: Kholo
description: Hyena-kin bound to a clan's laughter-code, who judge a stranger's honesty by what actually makes them laugh.

name: Vishkanya
description: Poison runs harmless in their own blood and lethal in a graze of skin, which keeps most handshakes deliberately short.

name: Kappa
description: River-spirits with a water-filled hollow atop their skulls, murderously formal about a bow returned incorrectly.

name: Encantado
description: River-dolphin shapeshifters who slip ashore for one dance and vanish before the music decides who they really were.

name: Goloma
description: Blind, four-armed cave-dwellers who read a room by the shape sound makes bouncing off it.

name: Shisk
description: Segmented night-hunters with a taste for silence, who consider daylight conversation a kind of rudeness.

name: Bunyip-touched
description: Marked by a childhood brush with the thing in the billabong, and treated ever after as a small walking warning.

name: Peri
description: Winged and exiled from a paradise they're still working off the debt to re-enter, one earned kindness at a time.

name: Echo-born
description: Formed from a moment loud enough to outlive itself; they carry a faint echo of it and flinch at loud silence.

name: Kasatha
description: Four-armed desert nomads who read the stars like a ledger and never camp somewhere the sky can't be seen.

name: Wyrwood
description: A construct carved from living wood, still growing new rings and never quite sure which one it started as.

name: Nahual
description: Born bonded to an animal spirit under the same stars; harm one and you'll feel it happen to the other.

name: Rakshasa-kin
description: Descendants of old shape-changing deceivers, welcomed at fewer tables than their manners would suggest they deserve.

name: Starveined
description: Born the night a star fell close enough to leave a thread of light under their skin, cold to the touch and faintly humming.

name: Ganzi
description: Marked by wild planar energy at birth — a faint aura that flickers when they're upset, which people have learned to watch for.

name: Wyvaran
description: Draconic blood a few generations back, and the temper skipped none of those generations to reach them.

name: Anansi-kin
description: Descended from the spider who out-thought every god in the old stories, and expected to out-think a few problems themselves.

name: Aziza
description: Tiny forest-dwellers said to teach magic to hunters who earn it, and famously stingy with anyone who tries to skip the earning.

name: Year-lent
description: Alive on years their village voted to lend them; they know exactly how many are left and never mention the number.

name: Wordbound
description: Every lie they tell surfaces as a new mark on their skin, and they've stopped wearing short sleeves in most towns.

name: Timeskipped
description: Occasionally lose months or years between one sleep and the next, and have learned to always ask what year it is first.

name: Resonant
description: Hums faintly with whatever a nearby crowd is feeling, and has learned to leave a room before a riot does.

name: Baku
description: Eats nightmares on request, and charges only in a very specific and easily forgotten kind of favour.

name: Menehune
description: Small forest-builders who finish a wall overnight and vanish before sunrise, on the condition nobody watches them work.

name: Sarangay
description: Ox-headed giant-kin who measure a season by the health of the nearest harvest, and take a poor one personally.

name: Duskwalker
description: Descended from a god who died and came back changed; they hear an echo of that change and try to live up to it.

name: Yeti-kin
description: Mountain-born and cold to the touch, blamed for every avalanche within a day's walk whether they were there or not.

name: Impundulu
description: Lightning-bird descendants who taste faintly of ozone before a storm, and are blamed for every roof that burns that week.

name: Cornerbound
description: Sealed a piece of themselves into a building's foundation at its raising, and feel every crack in it as their own.

name: Awakened Animal
description: Once ordinary livestock or vermin, until the day they woke up mid-thought and never stopped being surprised by it.

name: Shoony
description: Dog-folk caravaners who remember every debt and every kindness with the same unnerving accuracy.

name: Grioth
description: Void-touched and telepathic, uneasy on solid ground and homesick for a sky most people can't see the far side of.

name: Trox
description: Beetle-folk mercenaries who measure trust in scars and consider a shed carapace worth grieving.

name: Adze
description: Takes the shape of a firefly to slip through a crack in the wall, and always closes the door properly on the way back out.

name: Saltkin
description: Their sweat crystallises into salt overnight, which made them useful long before anyone asked if they minded.

name: Nullborn
description: Illusions slide off them untouched, which makes them excellent witnesses and terrible company at a magic show.

name: Penanggalan
description: Detaches at the neck by night and flies trailing everything else; mornings are, understandably, a private affair.

name: Duende
description: A house-imp who hides one shoe, one earring, one important letter — never more than one thing at a time.

name: Wayang
description: Small and quiet, born of the Shadow Plane, and unnerving to stand near in bright noon light for reasons nobody quite names.

name: Tollkin
description: Pays a small toll to cross any threshold not their own — a colour, a taste, a name — and keeps careful track of what's left.

name: Driftwood-born
description: Grown, not born, from wood the tide brought in; every year they walk back to where they washed up, whether they mean to or not.

name: Sigbin
description: Walks backward and low to the ground, invisible by daylight, and only proves it's real by the bruise it leaves.

name: Orang Bunian
description: Live one half-step out of sight in a parallel version of the same town, and occasionally trade places with a person who wandered too far off the path.

name: Ghoran
description: Grown from a single fruiting vine that bears one child a generation, and raised by whichever elder is still standing when they ripen.

name: Automaton
description: Built by a civilisation nobody can name anymore, and still following a purpose they're slowly having to guess at.

name: Kinlost
description: Swapped at birth by a rift nobody noticed opening; raised as themselves, and faintly certain somewhere else raised the original.

name: Ashgrown
description: Grown from the ash of a funeral pyre that burned a little too well; they carry one stranger's habit they never learned themselves.

name: Tikoloshe
description: Small, waterborne, and mischievous by long-standing reputation; most of what goes missing in a house gets blamed on them first and found later anyway.

name: Curupira
description: Forest-guardians with feet turned backward, who lead careless hunters in exact, furious circles until they learn better.

name: Gathlain
description: Fey grown from flower petals, who read a garden's health at a glance and hold a grudge against anyone who neglects one.

name: Aitvaras
description: Brings a household good fortune through means better not examined closely, and expects an omelette left out on Tuesdays.

name: Yeren
description: Tall, hair-covered forest-dwellers rarely seen and often blamed, with a reputation for shyness the sightings never quite support.

name: Mapinguari
description: Huge, shaggy, and reputedly foul-smelling on purpose, since nothing that valued eye contact would need only the one eye.

name: Vaultborn
description: Store their most important memories in small objects rather than their heads, and are extremely careful about pockets with holes.

name: Back-aged
description: Ages backward from their fortieth year onward, and has started quietly stocking up on childhood things they'll need again.

name: Numberbound
description: Bound to a number chosen at birth; every task must repeat in multiples of it, or it simply doesn't feel finished.

name: Ironboned
description: Had a rib replaced with worked iron at their coming-of-age, by their own choice, and the joint aches before any storm worth noticing.

name: Tripkee
description: Leaping messenger-folk who measure distance in jumps and consider any flat road a personal insult to their legs.

name: Sasabonsam
description: Long-legged and iron-footed, said to hang from the high branches and count on nobody thinking to look up.
